Body.Content:
Azure Percept extends compute and AI to the edge of a network to unlock new business scenarios designed from silicon to service. Start prototyping in minutes with Azure Percept development kit integrated with Azure AI and Azure IoT services and designed to be simple to use and ready to go with minimal setup. Azure Percept was designed in accordance with Microsoft’s responsible AI principles to help ensure all the services streamlined to create edge AI solutions that can adapt to customers’ needs while helping ensure customers’ trust as the edge evolves.

Learn more.
